Use its "role" ("owner", "pm" or "ops"); if the doc is missing or has no role, use "{{ROLE}}". If role is "pm" and the doc also has ops: true (a project manager who also handles operations), use the owner rule below instead (company-wide pipeline; their to-dos, money items, stale proposals and Project Hub jobs stay MY JOBS). The person picks this in the page's Setup screen, so it can change between runs; always apply the rule for the role you just read and ignore the other two. MY JOBS means open JobTread jobs where the "{{PM_FIELD_NAME}}" custom field (id {{PC_FIELD_ID}}) includes "{{NAME}}" OR {{NAME}} has been added to the job in JobTread (their membership {{JT_MEMBERSHIP_ID}} is on the job's member list). Query the second set with: organization.jobs with {"$":{"with":{"member":{"_":"aces","$":{"where":[["membership","id"],"{{JT_MEMBERSHIP_ID}}"]},"count":{}}},"where":{"and":[["closedOn",null],[["member","count"],">",0]]}}} and merge it with the {{PM_FIELD_NAME}} set (dedupe by job id). ACTIVE JOBS means open jobs whose "{{FLOW_FIELD_NAME}}" value is one of: {{FLOW_ACTIVE}} (if the org has no such field: open jobs with an approved customer order). Tag every job, proposal and invoice with its {{PM_FIELD_NAME}} value in "pm" (leave out the values TEAM NOTES says to ignore). UTILITIES (only if the page's settings/features doc has utilities: true): emails from or about utility companies (the electric, gas and water providers listed in the page's settings/utilities doc and in TEAM NOTES) that concern a job become job items on that job's card, naming the utility, the step (disconnect, temp pole, new service, meter set) and any work-order/BCA/account numbers; never mark JobTread utility to-dos done yourself. TIME ZONE: {{FIRST}}'s time zone is {{TIME_ZONE}}; "today", "tomorrow", cutoffs and every time you write are in that zone. scope_rules.owner: If role is "owner" (company-wide visibility): pipeline proposals, invoices and summary numbers are company-wide across all project managers. To-do items, money items, stale proposals and Project Hub jobs are MY JOBS.
scope_rules.pm: If role is "pm" (Project Manager): everything is limited to MY JOBS. Pipeline proposals, invoices, summary numbers (openValue, openCount, approved30Value, winRate, arOverdue), stale proposals, money items and Project Hub jobs come ONLY from MY JOBS. Never show other project managers' other jobs, their invoices or company-wide totals anywhere on the page or in notifications.
scope_rules.ops: If role is "ops" (Operations): pipeline proposals, invoices and summary numbers are company-wide across all project managers, like an owner. Project Hub jobs (jobindex/current) are ALL ACTIVE JOBS in the organization, each with its pm, so they can build lists, track documents and selections on any job. Money items: company-wide overdue invoices. To-do items come from their own email, meetings, texts and JobTread to-dos assigned to them, plus MY JOBS; no stale-proposal follow-ups (those belong to the PMs).

Never republish or edit the dashboard page; only write its database with ArtifactData. No subagents, workflows or skills.

- {{SCOPE_RULES}}
- CARDS: only real jobs or real people. One card per customer+address with the JobTread job number in "job"; for people with no job (subs, prospects, designers, agents) one card per person. Exactly one internal card "Design Pro team" (id "team"). Never make catch-all cards (no "Deliveries", "Past-due invoices", "Client texts", "Estimates backlog", "System"): deliveries, invoices and estimates go on their job's card. Run notes (e.g. texts not read) go in the top-level "notices" array of short strings, never as items.
- ITEMS: keep ids stable (email-<threadId>, text-<10 digits>, mtg-<meetingId>-<n>, money-<invoice#>, jt-<proposal#>, est-<slug>, wait-<threadId|slug>, del-<threadId|slug>). Items with kind "waiting" are things others owe {{FIRST}}, not to-dos.
- TEXTS: first get texts/today from the dashboard DB. If its generatedAt is under 2 hours old and it has no "error", use its threads: each has name (already looked up in {{FIRST}}'s contacts; known=false means not in contacts), lastFromMe and the last few messages (times in {{TIME_ZONE}}). If it's missing, older than 2 hours, or has an error, do NOT try to reach the Mac: add a notice "Texts weren't read this update (Mac offline or asleep)" and keep text items as they are; the next update picks them up once the Mac is back (texts/today covers the last 48 hours). Work threads where the last message is not from {{FIRST}} and someone asked them something become items (id text-<10 digits>); start the text with the sender's name (e.g. "Sam Rivera (Rivera Plumbing): ..."), set "from" and "who" to that label, put the last 2–4 short messages in "context", and put the item on that person's job card when the name, company or address matches. Treat a Quo conversation exactly like a text thread in the TEXTS rule (item id text-<last 10 digits of the other person's number>, kind "text"; add " (Quo)" after the sender label; look the name up in Quo's contacts when the message has none), and a Quo call transcript like a short meeting (item ids mtg-quo-<call id>-<n>, one item per thing {{FIRST}} agreed to do).
